info.title: Learning Content
info.description:
We are making updates to our collections. If you run into any issues pulling the latest changes, simply fork the collection again.

The 2 main uses for the externalized LinkedIn Learning APIs are for Learning Content and Learning Activity Reports.

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our* [*Partner Program*](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) *and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

Overview: [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/overview/](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/overview/)

* * *

Use this collection with the **LinkedIn Learning Solutions** environment

* * *

get.summary: Learning Assets by Individual Asset URN
get.description:
To retrieve an individual learning asset, given an URN, issue a GET request to the following endpoint:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningAssets/{URN}

The URN types supported by this endpoint are "urn:li:lyndaCourse", "urn:li:lyndaChapter", and "urn:li:lyndaVideo".


Documentation: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/integrations/retrieve-an-individual-learning-object#learningassets-get

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: targetLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language the API will use to try to localize the learning asset. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: targetLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country the API will use to try to localize the learning asset. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: expandDepth
parameters.description: The number of levels in the learning asset hierarchy to include asset details. Default is 1.

parameters.name: includeRetired
parameters.description: Whether to include retired learning assets. The value of this parameter should be true or false.

get.summary: Learning Assets by Locale and Type
get.description:
To retrieve a page of learning assets, given some criteria, issue a GET call to the following endpoint:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningAssets?q=localeAndType

Documentation: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/integrations/locale-and-type-api#learningassets-localeandtype-finder

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The value of this parameter should always be: localeAndType.

parameters.name: sourceLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language of the learning assets. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: sourceLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country of the learning assets. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: expandDepth
parameters.description: The number of levels in the learning asset hierarchy to include asset details. This parameter is optional; please see the Specifying the level of asset details section for an explanation with examples.

parameters.name: includeRetired
parameters.description: Whether to include retired learning assets. The value of this parameter should be true or false.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start index of learning assets for the page.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of learning assets to include in the page. Please choose a reasonable value if overriding the default; the API will return an error if the requested page exceeds the 2 MB response size limit of the framework.

get.description:
To retrieve learning classifications for a keyboard, use a GET request supplied with a keyword to receive all of the classifications for that keyword. [https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningClassifications?q=keyword&keyword=business](https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningClassifications/{URN})

Documentation: [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learningclassifications#keyword](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learningclassifications#keyword)

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The value of this parameter should always be keyword.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword string to search learning classifications. The search results will include only learning classifications matching this keyword string, as determined by LinkedIn Learning's relevance algorithm. The value of this parameter is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: sourceLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country the API will use to try to localize the learning classification. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: sourceLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language the API will use to try to localize the learning classification. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start index of learning classifications for the page.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of learning classifications to include in the page. The maximum supported count is 100 classifications per page.

get.description:
